# Decisions (ADR log)

When the Product Owner decides an approach, a trade-off, a scope cut or a rule, add an ADR to `compass/spec.json → decisions` in the same PR.

## ADR-001 · Compass follows its own delivery process

_2026-11-26 · Accepted · REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-003, REQ-004_

**Context:** Compass enforced the AI-native SDLC in other repos but not on its own code.

**Decision:** The Product Owner approved the intent: Compass's own repo gets the Compass Framework generated by the portal itself, CI on every pull request, tests for the checking scripts and a no-drift check between compass/ and src/framework/.

**Consequences:** Every later Compass PR needs an approved intent, approved requirements, a design (or none: <reason>), a plan file and an independent review. The setup PR is larger than 12 files because the check does not exist on main yet.

## ADR-002 · Light baseline for the existing portal

_2026-11-26 · Accepted_

**Context:** The portal existed before its repo had a spec.

**Decision:** The Product Owner chose a light baseline: one feature per stage (F-001…F-007) with one Done requirement each (REQ-101…107); detailed requirements are written only for new work.

**Consequences:** Older behaviour is documented at stage level only; new work starts at REQ-001.

## ADR-003 · Team floor is a live view of the existing run trace

_2026-11-26 · Accepted · REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008, REQ-009_

**Context:** The Product Owner asked for a realtime "creative team" interface like those other AI users built.

**Decision:** The Product Owner approved the intent for option 1: a Team floor page drawn only from the run trace Compass already records. Agents talking to each other and multi-device viewing are out of scope, each needing its own decision.

**Consequences:** No change to agents, tools, guardrails or approval gates; no extra Claude cost; live only in the browser tab that runs the agents.
